name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-06-09, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
